# STE80 Humanizer Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor: Rewrite AI-sounding English text so it reads like a clear, careful person wrote it, using two passes, one that removes 26 AI tells and one that rebuilds sentences with Simplified Technical English structure at 80 percent.

Three modes fit the job: Humanize by default, Light for a light touch, and Strict STE for procedures and safety notes. Fidelity rules keep every fact, keep the degree of certainty, and add nothing. It works in English only, and it leaves some text alone: no legal text, no code, no translation. Its guide also points to a small local checker script in the repo. By @Dodaios, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
